Aga's Restaurant is one of the busiest in the country, serving 4,000 customers every day at its main location in Houston. Its Pakistani and Indian menu features more than 100 items, all made fresh daily. It has also transformed into the busiest single-location restaurant on Uber Eats. Pulling that off takes a huge team and nonstop coordination. Here's how Aga's keeps up with the staggering demand.
